_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The images listed under verified are the official ones, the baseline on every run and the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag. Chroma's official image pins `dumb-init -- chroma` as its entrypoint and chroma is a CLI that reads its arguments as subcommands, so a sandbox `command` of `sleep infinity` becomes `chroma sleep infinity` and the container dies (measured 2026-09-13); the suite therefore runs the two-line wrapper the adapter README documents, built FROM the listed image, so the engine exercised is exactly the listed version's — the prometheus precedent. The wrapper adds nothing: the image already carries bash, and bash's /dev/tcp is this adapter's whole HTTP client, because the image has no curl, no python and no jq. Chroma publishes no end-of-life dates, so supported_until is null and versions_checked records the reading. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: Chroma

sources.chroma_data_tar: A tar archive of one, plain or gzip — the compression read from the bytes, never the name
sources.chroma_data: The persistence directory `chroma run --path` was given, copied with the server stopped
